reason: A dsh web UI skin that applies a blue-whale visual theme, responsive hero and conversation backgrounds, and reduced-motion-aware CSS effects.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面提供蓝鲸主题皮肤，包括自适应背景、统一配色令牌和可选动效。
summaries.en: A dsh web interface skin that adds a blue-whale theme with adaptive backgrounds, unified color tokens, and motion-aware visual effects.

capabilities: Modifies web interface theme tokens and styles
Injects client-side SVG artwork and DOM elements
Reads session state and layout measurements to adapt visual scenes
Supports installation and removal through the dsh plugin manager
